@graph.comment: ViewAssembler (view-layer spec §3.1) — executes the view descriptors' declared CONSTRUCT/SELECT projection queries via embedded @comunica/query-sparql over EXPLICIT sources (no link traversal; the Pod hosts no SPARQL endpoint per D3/D29). Parameterless: engine + serializers are constructed internally. Shared by both view HTTP handlers.

ViewHttpHandler — per-resource ?_profile= conneg (view-layer spec §4; read-path corrected by D114): fused|alt over resources in ANY tree (fused is the substrate-wide, content-type-agnostic governed-context contract: markdown -> body + fenced graph; RDF -> resource triples unioned with .meta as one turtle graph). Inserted BEFORE LdpHandler in the BaseHttpHandler waterfall (same QSA-interception precedent as WikiSearchHttpHandler / MementoHttpHandler), so ?_profile-shaped GETs are claimed before standard LDP processing and fall through (NotImplementedHttpError) otherwise. store = urn:solid-server:default:ResourceStore = the MonitoringStore instance. baseUrl is the deployment baseUrl variable (NOT a literal); viewsBase is the pod-specific view-descriptor container (hardcoded string, same idiom as the AdmissionFloor stampPredicate / markdown-render storagePath). (D114 removed the doc/graph tokens + the TrailerDecoratingStore.)

ViewSpaceHttpHandler — the /vault/views/ cross-cutting virtual URL space (view-layer spec §6; Person demonstrator at /vault/views/people/). Read-only; assembles one entity from its multiple writable homes via a descriptor CONSTRUCT, sources enumerated through the Type Index (no source hardcode, D107). Inserted BEFORE LdpHandler alongside ViewHttpHandler. Same Monitoring-level store ref as ViewHttpHandler (bypasses the trailer). viewSpaceRoot = the served container path; typeIndexUrl = the Type Index used to enumerate person-class source containers.
